{"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_frame.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":21,"var":"data,size","code":"blosc2_schunk_from_buffer((uint8_t *) data, size, false)","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are interpreted as an in-memory frame, so malformed frame metadata can reach the decompressor."},
{"step":2,"file":"blosc/schunk.c","function":"blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk","line":863,"var":"schunk->frame","code":"if (schunk->frame != NULL) return frame_decompress_chunk(schunk->dctx, frame, nchunk, dest, nbytes);","note":"The frame-backed path bypasses the simple buffer path and delegates chunk handling to frame_decompress_chunk."},
{"step":3,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_decompress_chunk","line":1877,"var":"frame_get_lazychunk(...)","code":"frame_get_lazychunk(frame, nchunk, &src, &needs_free)","note":"Decompression of a frame chunk first fetches a lazy chunk object, which may be heap-allocated and marked needs_free."},
{"step":4,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1945,"var":"*chunk","code":"*chunk = malloc(lazychunk_cbytes); *needs_free = true;","note":"For non-contiguous frames, the function allocates a synthetic lazy-chunk buffer and returns ownership to the caller."},
{"step":5,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":2015,"var":"*chunk","code":"memcpy(trailer_csizes, block_csizes, nblocks * sizeof(int32_t));","note":"The allocated lazy-chunk buffer is populated with attacker-influenced chunk and block metadata extracted from the frame."},
{"step":6,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_decompress_chunk","line":null,"var":"src","code":"The returned lazy chunk is used as decompression input and later freed when needs_free is true.","note":"The caller treats the returned buffer as a temporary chunk object and frees it after use, so malformed metadata can drive invalid ownership/free behavior on the chunk path."}
]
